unit.title: Measure
unit.blurb: Measuring mass in grams and kilograms, capacity in millilitres and litres, and temperature in degrees Celsius, reading scales.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Estimate and measure mass in grams and kilograms, and read scales.

O2.t: Estimate and measure capacity in millilitres and litres.

O3.t: Read temperatures in degrees Celsius on a thermometer.

p: **Mass** tells us how heavy something is. Light things are measured in **grams (g)**; heavier things in **kilograms (kg)**.
**1000 g = 1 kg**. Read the scale carefully: work out what each small mark is worth.
If marks go 0, 1, 2 kg with a mark between each, that mark shows a half.

p: **Capacity** is how much a container holds. Small amounts are measured in **millilitres (ml)**; larger amounts in **litres (l)**.
**1000 ml = 1 l**. A spoon holds about 5 ml; a big bottle holds about 2 l.

lesson.t: Read the top of the liquid
p: Read the level where the top of the water is, looking straight at it.

p: **Temperature** tells us how hot or cold something is. We measure it in **degrees Celsius (°C)** with a **thermometer**.
Water freezes at 0 °C and boils at 100 °C. A warm day might be 25 °C.
On a thermometer each mark might be 2 °C or 5 °C. Check before you read.
